scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @prometheus/protocol build && concurrently -n server-rs,client -c yellow,cyan "pnpm dev:server-rs" "pnpm --filter @prometheus/client dev"
scripts.dev:node: pnpm --filter @prometheus/protocol build && concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter @prometheus/server dev" "pnpm --filter @prometheus/client dev"
scripts.tauri:dev: pnpm --filter @prometheus/protocol build && pnpm --filter @prometheus/client exec tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: pnpm --filter @prometheus/protocol build && pnpm --filter @prometheus/client exec tauri build
scripts.tauri:android:build: pnpm --filter @prometheus/protocol build && pnpm --filter @prometheus/client exec tauri android build --apk --config src-tauri/tauri.mobile.conf.json
scripts.tauri:ios:build: pnpm --filter @prometheus/protocol build && pnpm --filter @prometheus/client exec tauri ios build --config src-tauri/tauri.mobile.conf.json
